definition: A neural radiance field method for transparent scenes that adapts to the Index of Refraction (IOR) to correctly model refraction, avoiding the artifacts and wrong radiance field learning seen in standard NeRF.
summary: NeRRF is an inverse rendering method for transparent scenes that reconstructs geometry and radiance fields by automatically optimizing the Index of Refraction to eliminate visual artifacts.
